annotations.title: Get what fee-only advisors typically charge

description: Use this when the person asks what a fee-only financial advisor costs, or whether a price they were quoted is typical. Returns the median and the middle half (25th to 75th percentile) of what fee-only firms charge for ongoing planning per year, a one-time plan, an hourly rate, and a percentage of assets, with how many firms each figure is drawn from. Pass country, and region (a US state slug) for that state's figures next to the country's; states where too few firms publish prices return the country figures only, and there are no provincial figures for Canada. Figures are starting prices that firms publish on their own websites, one per firm, from the latest quarterly edition of the Wellspent fee report: describe them as published prices, not as what the person will pay. State the edition and cite "Source: Wellspent fee report, find.wellspent.co" with the report's url.

country.description: "us" for the United States (US dollars), "ca" for Canada (Canadian dollars).

region.description: Optional US state or Canadian province slug (e.g. "california"). Must be in the given country.
